function: Joint design of the BS precoding matrix and the RIS phase shifts to maximize weighted spectral efficiency in a RIS-aided MU-MISO downlink (p. 3, p. 4).
system: mmWave 28 GHz MU-MISO: 64-antenna BS, passive reflecting RIS with 100 elements, 4 single-antenna users, direct link blocked (p. 3, p. 6).
method: Self-supervised meta learning: two small MLPs (Precoding, Theta Network) map SE gradients to updates; Adam on negative-SE loss, random initialization, no pre-training (p. 4, p. 5).
data_channel: Simulated Rician channels (K-factor 10) with 3GPP path loss [41]; 100 channel realizations; dynamic scenarios use channel data from standards [41], [43] (p. 6, p. 7, p. 10).
test_conditions: No pre-training: networks are randomly initialized and optimized for each channel realization; sweeps of power, N, M, CEE; dynamic scenarios at 0, 60, 120 km/h (p. 7-10).
baselines: Non-learned: random phase with WMMSE, AO [10]. Learned: DNN [42]; own ablations GML and ML (p. 7).
metrics: Spectral efficiency versus power, RIS size, BS antennas, epochs and channel estimation error; CPU time; SE variance (p. 7-9).
complexity: O(Ne No Ni K^2 M N) versus AO O(L3(L1 K M^3+L2 K^2 N^2)) (Table III); CPU time 4.7 s versus 108.1 s for AO (p. 6, p. 8).
q1_support: p. 10: "Technical standards [41] and [43] are separately used to generate perfect channel data for stationary and moving scenarios"; [41], [43] are 3GPP TS 36.814 and TS 36.885 (p. 12). The main results use custom Rician channels with 3GPP path loss only (p. 6, p. 7).
q2_support: p. 10: "the embedded NNs are updated within each channel optimization, but are randomly initialized across each channel realization"; no trained model is tested on an unseen scenario, so each condition is retrained from scratch.
q3_support: p. 7: "Baseline 4 (DNN): The deep learning model in [42] is adopted"; the non-learned baselines are random phase with WMMSE and AO [10] (p. 7), all compared on SE (Fig. 4, p. 8).
q4_support: p. 6: "The complexity of GMML has been proven to be O(Ne No Ni K 2 M N )"; p. 8 gives the measured time of 4.7 seconds against 108.1 seconds for AO.
q5_support: p. 3: "The code for this paper is available online in [35]."; [35] is https://github.com/fenghaozhu/GMML (p. 12).
notes: Area 3: the networks set the BS precoder and the RIS phases (p. 4-5). Included as learned because the NNs are trained with Adam on a self-supervised SE loss (p. 5), but there is no pre-training and the NNs are re-initialized for each channel (p. 10), so the reviewer should confirm that this is not no_learning. q1 is borderline: the main results use a custom Rician simulator with 3GPP path loss (does not count), and only the dynamic scenario of Fig. 13 uses channel data generated with the 3GPP standards TS 36.814 and TS 36.885 (p. 10), which the reviewer should confirm.
